title: IBGE Releases Brazil's World Maps for 2024–2026
subtitle: Maps will be accessible via the IBGE online store starting September 7
excerpt: Starting tomorrow, September 7, IBGE will make Brazil's 2024–2026 world maps available on its online store following UN approval.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics (IBGE) will release, starting tomorrow (7), Brazil's Independence Day, access to the country's world maps for the 2024–2026 period. The material will be made available on the IBGE store website.

UN-Approved Version

The latest version of these maps received global approval last Friday (4) during the United Nations (UN) General Assembly.

Interested parties will be able to access the files directly through the IBGE store portal, where they will be available for download and consultation.

With information from Agência Brasil.
